title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF TWO THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED AND FIFTY DOLLARS, IN MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, TO BE PAID TO DANIEL E. DWYER AND CHARLES E. HERRON, IN FULL COMPENSATION FOR THEIR SERVICES AND EXPENSES IN APPREHENDING AND DELIVERING TO THE AUTHORITIES OF MANILA WILLIAM A WILSON, A FUGITIVE FROM JUSTICE.
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF TWO THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED AND FIFTY DOLLARS, IN MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, TO BE PAID TO DANIEL E. DWYER AND CHARLES E. HERRON, IN FULL COMPENSATION FOR THEIR SERVICES AND EXPENSES IN APPREHENDING AND DELIVERING TO THE AUTHORITIES OF MANILA WILLIAM A WILSON, A FUGITIVE FROM JUSTICE.
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp khoản tiền hai nghìn hai trăm năm mươi đô la Mỹ để bồi thường đầy đủ cho Daniel E. Dwyer và Charles E. Herron vì dịch vụ và chi phí phát sinh trong việc bắt giữ và bàn giao William A. Wilson – kẻ trốn tránh công lý – cho cơ quan chức năng tại Thành phố Manila
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรงบประมาณสองพันสองร้อยห้าสิบดอลลาร์สหรัฐเพื่อชดเชยอย่างครบถ้วนแด่แดเนียลอีดไวเยอร์และชาร์ลส์อีเฮอร์รอนสำหรับบริการและค่าใช้จ่ายในการจับกุมและส่งมอบวิลเลียมเอกวิลสันผู้หลบหนีกระบวนการยุติธรรมให้หน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้องในนครมะนิลา
title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan jumlah dua ribu dua ratus lima puluh dolar Amerika Serikat sebagai kompensasi penuh bagi Daniel E. Dwyer dan Charles E. Herron atas jasa dan biaya mereka dalam menangkap serta menyerahkan William A. Wilson, seorang buronan, kepada otoritas di Kota Manila
title.ms: Akta mengeluarkan peruntukan dua ribu dua ratus lima puluh dolar Amerika Syarikat sebagai pampasan penuh kepada Daniel E. Dwyer dan Charles E. Herron bagi perkhidmatan dan perbelanjaan mereka dalam menangkap dan menyerahkan William A. Wilson seorang buruan kepada pihak berkuasa di Bandar Manila

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated,
the sum of two thousand two hundred and fifty dollars. United States currency, to be paid to Daniel E. Dwyer
and Charles E. Herron, special agents of the Department of Justice of the United States, in full compensation
for their services and expenses in apprehending and delivering to the authorities of Manila William A.
Wilson, a fugitive from justice, charged with embezzlement of Government funds.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act, prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 20, 1903.
